extcost-add-atom-into-a-pool-with-a-decl.comment: Lowered 78219 -> 65219 on 2026-08-21, 72.01 -> 60.01 inferences per add: space-admission-verdict reads the fixed admits and capacity heads directly from &petta's boot-created native storage. Lowered again 55.01 -> 48.01: petta_hook_eval calls the compiled fire clause directly when its declaring module is already current, retaining with_metta_module for the cross-module case. Semantics are pinned by metta_has_declared_type, hooks_compiled_fire, hooks_admission_sugar, and the admission differential.

P12.4 lowered 4574905 -> 111227 by replacing per-add atom enumeration with space_atom_count/2. Direct fixed-head contract reads lowered 103.02 -> 91.01 inferences per add on 2026-08-21. extcost-add-atom-no-claims-on-the-space.comment: Lowered 54223 -> 34225 on 2026-08-20 with P12.4, 49.22 -> 29.01 inferences per add: petta_install_admission wrapped metta_add_atom globally, so once any pool declared a contract EVERY space's adds paid the wrapper's forall over the contract atoms. Enforcement is a per-pool hook claim now, and a space nothing claimed keeps the direct write path.

extcost-add-atom-through-an-accept-all-p.comment: Claim-time compilation first lowered this row from 234.03 to 64.02 inferences per add, and P12.4 removed the global admission wrapper. extcost-m-define-annotated.comment: Lowered from 75241 on 2026-08-16, -27000 over 3000 calls, which is nine inferences per call. A literal argument's type is settled while the call site compiles, so translate_args_by_type_dl/7 emits no has_type/2 check for one; a call whose arguments are all literals of the declared types now compiles to exactly what the untyped one does, with no once/1 wrapper either. The published table's annotated row moved 20.00 -> 11.00 inferences per call and 6.67x -> 3.67x against an ordinary MeTTa function. The drop is one-directional and never rejects: a literal of the WRONG declared type keeps its check and is still refused, because a get-type extension may give a literal a second type and deciding that statically would be unsound. Guarded by translator_literal_type_checks in tests/prolog/translator.plt.
